dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white horizontal band on the greater coverts and a smaller, distinct white patch on the median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast white boundaries along the edges of the folded primaries and secondaries against dark grey feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Narrow, elongated white patch visible on the lateral-posterior neck boundary.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Soft but distinct color transition from the dark blackish-grey nape to the lighter olive-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct white cheek and auricular patch contrasting against a black throat and crown.
